text.p: Hungarian home improvement product manufacturer Graboplast Rt said on Saturday it merged its two wall-waper producing units within the group.
"A joint wall-paper manufacturer was established within the Grabo-group under the name Grabetta Keszta Kft, effective July 1," Graboplast's Chairman Peter Jansco told a news conference.
"This manufacturer joins wall-paper production in Gyor (west Hungary) and in Kesztolc (northwest of Budapest)."
Kesztolc-based Keszta, acquired by the Graboplast-group in April 1996, generated a pre-tax profit of 103 million forints on net sales of 801 million last year.
Graboplast's wall-paper production in Gyor was a division of group member Grabo Ltd which reported a pre-tax profit of 1.141 billion forints on net sales of 8.315 billion in 1996.
Jancso said Grabetta Keszta is expected to generate a pre-tax profit of over 200 million forints on sales of almost one billion forints in the third quarter of the year.
Second quarter figures were not yet available.
Jancso said Grabetta Keszta's capital is 532 million forints as Graboplast raised Keszta's 232 million capital by 300 million on July 1.
The Graboplast group also produces PVC floor covers, artificial leather, carpets, wall-papers, tablecloth and other fine textiles.
On Friday Graboplast shares rallied to a new record high of 9,300 forints before they retreated to finish at 9,000 forints, down 100.
